Brooklyn 7:00 AM– EDT Learn More NYCRUNS will host over 20,000 runners at the sold-out NYCRUNS Brooklyn Experience Half Marathon will host over 20,000 on Sunday, April 26, 2026. This event features a unique course that takes participants through some of Brooklyn’s most iconic neighborhoods. The race route begins in vibrant North Brooklyn and winds along the waterfront, guiding runners beneath the historic Williamsburg, Manhattan, and Brooklyn Bridges, all while showcasing stunning views of Manhattan. Runners then navigate the historic concourses of Fulton Street and Flatbush Avenues, pass through Grand Army Plaza, and make their way into the famed brownstone areas of Brooklyn, finishing in Prospect Park. Participation includes a $1,000 fundraising commitment.
